title: All day: Evening / Sunday open 18:00-20:00 - mr (long-view pick that was positive in 2025, H1 and H2)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: start trading 24/7 - which setups work in each part of the NQ day, at the same or a higher win rate than LIT?
notes: tools/allday.py, variant mr|open18|vwap,2.5|S,None,w; picked: long-view pick that was positive in 2025, H1 and H2 (chosen after looking)

rules: Stretch: the last 6 candles reached >= 2.5 x the 5m ATR(14) beyond the session VWAP (from 18:00).
Trigger: a 5m close beyond the prior candle's high (long) / low (short), still on the stretched side.
Stop 1 tick beyond the 6-candle extreme; the setup's own level = the anchor (VWAP / window open).
Target the setup's own level (see above; >= 1R away, banked at 8R).
Time exit: flat at the window end + 60 min. One trade a day. Entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop and time exits - 1 tick; $1.40 a micro.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); stops 6-80 pts.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
